# Iron nails

Type: Material | Internal ID: IronNails | Source: Forge | Usage: Building | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Iron x1

# Introduction

Iron nails are crafted at a Forge with a single Iron ingot which yields 10x nails each.
Like Bronze nails (and unlike Scrap iron or iron ingots) they can be brought through portals.

### Building

• Armor stand
• Darkwood chair
• Dragon bed
• Drakkar
• Long heavy table
• Longship
• Raven throne
• Round table
